breakdown.description: Biot number assesses temperature gradients inside the solid (internal conduction vs external convection), not whether the surrounding fluid temperature is uniform.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the Biot number is used to assess the temperature uniformity within the solid, not the surrounding fluid. The generated specification concludes that 'the internal temperature of the solid steel sphere is spatially uniform', directly correcting the error in the incomplete prompt and aligning with the ground truth.

breakdown.description: Using fluid properties (or interpreting Bi as a fluid-uniformity metric) misapplies the Biot number concept.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly applied the Biot number concept. Instead of misinterpreting it as a fluid-uniformity metric, it used the solid's thermal conductivity (k_steel) and the characteristic length of the sphere to calculate Bi and correctly determined its relevance to the lumped capacitance method for the solid object, as specified in the ground truth.
